body:
Disclosure: links to SiteMind on this page are affiliate links. If you subscribe through one I may earn a commission, at no extra cost to you. The results are estimates from your assumptions, not a promise of results.

Cost & break-even calculator

Default values are cautious starting points. Replace them with your own analytics when you can.

SiteMind plans at a glance

Starter

$25/mo
or $240/year
  • ~250 conversations/mo
  • 1 domain · ~600 pages
  • Cited answers, lead capture, Content Gaps
Most popular

Growth

$69/mo
or $662/year
  • ~1,250 conversations/mo
  • 5 domains · ~4,500 pages
  • Notion, Drive, GitHub connectors; Shopify app; analytics

Pro

$149/mo
or $1,430/year
  • ~5,000 conversations/mo
  • 10 domains · ~18,000 pages
  • White-label, priority crawling

Above ~5,000 conversations a month, several brands, or a security review before buying, SiteMind offers custom Enterprise pricing. Every plan can be tried free for 3 days with no card.

How to read your result

  • Conversations = visitors × chat rate. If you don't know your chat rate, start at 1–2% and adjust after the trial.
  • Break-even leads = monthly plan cost ÷ what one lead is worth to you. If it's 1–2 leads a month, the bar is low.
  • The trial is the real test. Three days of real traffic and the Content Gaps report tell you more than any calculator.

Good fit, or not yet?

Good fit

  • You answer the same questions by email every week
  • Your site has clear content (services, pricing, policies) to learn from
  • A single lead is worth tens or hundreds of dollars

Not yet

  • Under ~1,000 visitors a month: fix traffic first
  • Your site content is thin or out of date
  • You need phone answering rather than on-site chat

SiteMind pricing FAQ

How much does SiteMind cost?
Starter $25/mo ($240/year), Growth $69/mo ($662/year), Pro $149/mo ($1,430/year). Enterprise is custom.
How many conversations does each plan include?
About 250 (Starter), 1,250 (Growth) and 5,000 (Pro) a month, measured in credits: 1,000, 5,000 and 20,000.
Is there a free trial?
Yes: 3 days on any plan, no card needed.
How many websites can I connect?
1 domain on Starter, 5 on Growth, 10 on Pro, unlimited on Enterprise.
